faqs.question: How long does the import process take?
faqs.answer: The typical import process takes 4-8 weeks from auction purchase to delivery in Sri Lanka. This includes auction, shipping (2-3 weeks), customs clearance (1-2 weeks), and final delivery.

faqs.question: What documents are required for vehicle import?
faqs.answer: You will need your NIC/Passport copy, Vehicle Import License (if applicable), Bank documents for payment verification, and completed import declaration forms. We assist with all documentation.

faqs.question: Do you offer financing options?
faqs.answer: Yes, we partner with leading banks in Sri Lanka to offer competitive financing options. We can arrange up to 70% financing for qualified buyers with flexible repayment terms.

faqs.question: How do I track my vehicle?
faqs.answer: Once logged into your dashboard, you can track your vehicle in real-time. We provide updates at every stage - from auction purchase, shipping, port arrival, customs clearance, to final delivery.

faqs.question: What warranty do you provide?
faqs.answer: All our vehicles come with a comprehensive inspection report. We offer a 6-month engine and transmission warranty on selected vehicles. Extended warranty packages are also available.

faqs.question: Can I choose a specific vehicle from Japanese auctions?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! We can bid on specific vehicles based on your requirements. Share your preferences (make, model, year, budget) and we'll find matching vehicles at upcoming auctions.

processSteps.title: Requirement Identification
processSteps.description: We begin with discussing the requirement, budget and select the vehicle.

processSteps.title: Estimate Price
processSteps.description: After requirement gathering, we will analyse the recent auction prices, taxes and other information and share the estimate import price.

processSteps.title: Advance Payment
processSteps.description: An advance payment is required to proceed with the confirmation.

processSteps.title: Auction Bidding & Purchasing
processSteps.description: We'll start bidding in auctions or purchasing the vehicle directly from dealers within a two weeks period. If we couldn't secure the vehicle at the price we agreed within two weeks, we'll refund the advance payment.

processSteps.title: Open the LC
processSteps.description: We'll provide the auction images, auction sheets and proforma invoice and you can open the LC from any bank as you prefer.

processSteps.title: Arrange the Shipment
processSteps.description: Shipment arranged within 2-4 weeks after the LC confirmation. During this period, vehicle will arrive to Japan port yards and inspection process will commence. We'll share the yard photos and the inspection certificate once those are done.

processSteps.title: Shipping and Arrival
processSteps.description: Vehicle will arrive to Hambantota port within 2 weeks after the ship departs from Japan.

processSteps.title: Customs Clearance
processSteps.description: Once the vehicle documents arrive to the bank, we can start the customs clearance process. At this stage, you can make the import duty payment directly to Sri Lanka Customs.

processSteps.title: Vehicle Delivery
processSteps.description: Finally we can collect the vehicle from Hambantota port and deliver your dream car!
